styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a roughly square block: a brown top strip over a dark grid with small reddish dots (bottles). All of its dark edge pixels (100%) are neutral, so the outline is near-black rather than tinted. The references that carry tinted dark tones (stall 1%, hedge 0%) read as dark material tone, which this does not. The rack reads as a flat dark rectangle with a regular dot pattern. It has no wood grain, no highlights on the frame, and no per-bottle shading, and it lacks the form definition of the stall or the well. The bottle dots repeat uniformly and give a mechanical texture rather than hand-shaded detail. Shading depth on the wood is about 3 steps against 5-6 in the references. Overall it looks like a sticker-like, shallow piece next to the references.
